var SaleListComponent = class _SaleListComponent {
  service = inject(SaleService);
  sales = signal(
    [],
    ...ngDevMode ? [{ debugName: "sales" }] : (
      /* istanbul ignore next */
      []
    )
  );
  loading = signal(
    true,
    ...ngDevMode ? [{ debugName: "loading" }] : (
      /* istanbul ignore next */
      []
    )
  );
  constructor() {
    this.load();
  }
  load() {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (sales) => {
        this.sales.set(sales);
        this.loading.set(false);
      },
      error: () => this.loading.set(false)
    });
  }
  cancel(sale) {
    if (!confirm(`Cancel sale ${sale.receiptNumber}?`))
      return;
    this.service.cancel(sale.id).subscribe(() => this.load());
  }
